meaning: Canonical source locations and maturity labels only. Registry membership is not production certification.

status_definitions.canonical-source: Authoritative owner path for the current domain implementation or contract; use subject to capability-specific readiness gates.
status_definitions.implementation-scaffold: Canonical integration/API location with incomplete provider, persistence, model, or end-to-end behavior; do not advertise as live.
status_definitions.demo-surface: Presentation/demo application source; it is not a security or decision authority.
status_definitions.scope-documentation-only: A documented ownership or contract scope whose runtime implementation is not yet verified; documentation presence does not authorize imports or deployment.

promotion_policy: A candidate may be promoted only through a reviewed PR that records provenance, contract comparison, one canonical owner, dependency/license/security/privacy review, tests, migration/rollback where applicable, and registry/documentation updates.
